lines.en: I called the client at four, but she had already left the office for the day.
lines.pt: Liguei para a cliente às quatro, mas ela já tinha saído do escritório naquele dia.

lines.en: Oh no. Was the contract ready before she left, or hadn’t she signed it yet?
lines.pt: Ah, não. O contrato estava pronto antes de ela sair, ou ela ainda não o tinha assinado?

lines.en: She had just signed it when I called, so her assistant answered the phone.
lines.pt: Ela tinha acabado de assinar quando liguei, então a assistente atendeu o telefone.

lines.en: Good. Had the finance team already sent her the final figures?
lines.pt: Ótimo. A equipe financeira já tinha enviado a ela os números finais?

lines.en: No, they hadn’t sent them yet, because the system had crashed twice that morning.
lines.pt: Não, eles ainda não tinham enviado, porque o sistema tinha travado duas vezes naquela manhã.

lines.en: That explains everything. By lunchtime, I had already written three emails about the problem.
lines.pt: Isso explica tudo. Na hora do almoço, eu já tinha escrito três e-mails sobre o problema.

lines.en: And had the manager replied yet? He had just come back from a conference in Leeds.
lines.pt: E o gerente já tinha respondido? Ele tinha acabado de voltar de uma conferência em Leeds.

lines.en: Not yet. When I knocked on his door, he had only just sat down.
lines.pt: Ainda não. Quando bati na porta dele, ele tinha acabado de sentar.

lines.en: Then we should wait. I had hoped to send everything today, but it hasn’t worked out.
lines.pt: Então devemos esperar. Eu esperava enviar tudo hoje, mas não deu certo.

lines.en: Don’t panic. I had already prepared a backup copy before the system failed.
lines.pt: Não entre em pânico. Eu já tinha preparado uma cópia de segurança antes de o sistema falhar.

lines.en: You are a lifesaver, Mia! I hadn’t even thought of that.
lines.pt: Você me salvou, Mia! Eu nem tinha pensado nisso.

facts.big: had already / had just / hadn’t … yet
facts.label: Past perfect com already, just, yet
facts.sub: Já tinha: had already + particípio. Tinha acabado de: had just + particípio. Ainda não tinha: hadn’t + particípio + yet.

facts.label: Já tinha
facts.sub: Had already mostra que algo estava terminado antes de outro momento no passado. Já fica entre had e o particípio: She had already left when I called. Em português, é “já tinha saído”.

facts.label: Ainda não tinha
facts.sub: Para dizer que algo ainda não estava feito até um momento no passado, use hadn’t + particípio + yet no fim da frase: They hadn’t sent them yet. Yet quase nunca aparece em frases afirmativas.

items.why: Yet is used in questions and negatives.

pages.title: A difficult day at the office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a grey Thursday afternoon in an office in Manchester. Rain hits the tall windows, and the phones keep ringing. Bo has been trying to reach an important client all day. His coworker Eva sits at the next desk with her laptop. A contract must be sent before the end of the week. Bo wants to explain what had already gone wrong.

“I called the client at four, but she had already left the office for the day.” says Bo. “Oh no. Was the contract ready before she left, or hadn’t she signed it yet?” says Eva. “She had just signed it when I called, so her assistant answered the phone.” says Bo.
